observations.claim: Candidate 5 was best at 11.56280 versus 12.11504 for nearest neighbor. It maximizes a savings score with a demand multiplier. The direct closure-cost variants in this round were worse, and its savings are all zero at the depot.

next_search_advice.direction: Separate route start from in-route savings.

memory_action.name: depot-savings-route-start
memory_action.description: CVRP depot savings and degenerate route starts
memory_action.body:
**Why:** Round 1 candidate 5 improved the mean from 12.11504 to 11.56280 with demand-weighted savings. At the depot its savings formula is identically zero in exact arithmetic.

**How to apply:** Preserve savings during a route as a useful candidate family. Give route starts an explicit comparator and check per-instance distance rather than assuming the start policy helps.

**Limitations:** Frozen six-instance CVRP development suite and current evaluator only.
